The '''Imperial Station Captain''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Korriban's Flame]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A fair-skinned woman with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] wore the dark gray dress uniform of an Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]], complete with a small hat, and wielded two powerful [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] in combat.<ref name="Fallen" /> Around [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Leeha Narezz]] [[Mission to the Korriban's Flame|lured]] the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] to the Korriban's Flame as part of a plan to trap the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and the captain was among those Imperials who [[Death/Legends|fell]] to the Knight's [[Lightsaber/Legends|blade]] while attempting to defend the station.<ref name="Fallen" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Station Captain first appeared in the Jedi Knight class mission "Fallen" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Fallen" />
